Name: At Your Service-Watering Helper
Author: NecroZide
Description:
🌱 At Your Service – Watering HelperTired of watering crops every day? Let someone else handle it!
[b]At Your Service[/b] provides a convenient crop watering service that automatically waters your crops for a fair price, so you can focus on more important things — mining, fishing, or just relaxing.
Simply subscribe, and your crops will be taken care of!
[line]✨ Features✔ Automatic crop watering service
✔ Works on:
[list]
[*]Main Farm
[*]Greenhouse
[*]Ginger Island Farm
[/list]✔ Will NOT water:
[list]
[*]Already watered crops (sprinklers or rain)
[*]Crops on rainy days
[/list]✔ Fully compatible with Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b]
✔ Immersive and balanced gold cost system
✔ No cheating — you must be able to afford the service
[line]💰 Watering CostLocationCost per Tile
You are only charged for tiles that actually need watering.
Already watered crops are skipped and not charged.
[line]⌨ ControlsPress:
[b]L key[/b] → Toggle Subscription
You will see:
[list]
[*]"Watering service subscribed!"
[*]"Watering service canceled!"
[/list][line]⏰ Important Rules✔ Subscribe [b]before 8:00 AM[/b] for watering on the same day
✔ Service waters at:
[list]
[*]8:00 AM
[*]4:00 PM
[/list]✔ Service will NOT work if:
[list]
[*]You don't have enough gold
[/list]✔ Service will NOT water:
[list]
[*]Sprinkler-watered crops
[*]Rain-watered crops
[/list]✔ Service automatically cancels when you exit the game
You must resubscribe each time you start the game.
[line]🌧 Rain SupportThe service intelligently detects rainy weather.
No watering
No charges
[line]⚖ Balanced & FairThis mod is designed to:
[list]
[*]Feel immersive
[*]Stay balanced
[*]Not break progression
[*]Not replace sprinklers entirely
[/list]Sprinklers still provide maximum efficiency.
[line]🧩 RequirementsSMAPI (Latest version)
Stardew Valley 1.6
[line]📦 Installation[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI

[*]Download this mod

[*]Extract into:

[/list]Stardew Valley/Mods
[list=1]
[*]Launch the game

[/list]Done!
[line]❤️ Why I Made ThisThis mod is perfect for:
[list]
[*]Early game convenience
[*]Players who hate watering chores
[*]Roleplaying farm management
[*]Relaxed playthroughs
[/list][line]🛠 Compatibility✔ Stardew Valley 1.6
✔ Singleplayer
✔ Multiplayer safe
[line]🐞 BugsReport in Posts tab.
